title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (September, 2025)
summary: September 2025 cumulative updates for Business Central cover BC27 public preview, BC26 CU05 with environment management features, BC25 CU11, and BC24 CU17. The post includes lifecycle dates, version build numbers, and links to detailed release notes.
key_points: BC27 (2025 wave 2) is in public preview with full release plan available
BC26 CU05 introduces production and sandbox environment management in Admin Center
BC25 changed major update cycle from 30/60 days to 5 months with optional minor updates
Multiple versions supported with staggered end-of-life dates from October 2023 through October 2026

quotes.text: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights a key new capability in BC26 CU05 for cloud deployment management

quotes.text: Business Central 2024 wave 2 (BC25): Manage environment updates more flexibly - Major update: 30(60) days -> 5-month and Optional minor updates
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes significant change to update policy reducing frequency and adding optionality
